messages:
SRE Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P1 - SERVICE_DISCOVERY_ERRORS in us-west-2b. Multiple SRV lookups failing (Consul/etcd path). On-call: Kai (on-call) paged. Please ack and join.
Kai (on-call): acked, joining. I see elevated SRV error rate in telemetry.
Nadia - Prod Telemetry: Graphs: internal.srv_lookup.errors spike ~ 00:01 UTC across us-west-2b only. 95th latency for SRV queries up to 3.2s, SERVFAIL count increased.
Kai (on-call): quick customer impact check — Maya, any user reports?
Maya - Support: I have 2 active tickets: Customer A (dedicated) intermittent 503s for chat APIs; Customer B reporting long tail timeouts on startup. Both clusters in us-west-2. Raising severity to P1.
Liam - Infra: I'm seeing extra packet drops on the AZ vpc-egress path to our internal consul endpoints. Might be a routing flap across AZ B.
Anya P: Consul leader elections in us-west-2b show frequent leader changes over last 6m. Possibly network partition between nodes.
Kai (on-call): plan: 1) mitigate customer impact (failover routing), 2) stabilize service discovery, 3) postmortem. Who can do quick routing policy change?
Liam - Infra: I can push an emergency routing rule to favor us-west-2a endpoints for SRV queries. Will push a temporary route weight shift.
Jamal R: Noted — will prepare a canary override in Redwood router to route SRV traffic away from us-west-2b.
Kai (on-call): execute step 1 now. Keep change small (10% -> 90% shift) and monitor.
Liam - Infra: applying change (edge-control CLI):
```
edge-control route update --service consul-srv --region us-west-2 --weights us-west-2a=90,us-west-2b=10 --reason "incident 1918765432 temporary failover"
```
Liam - Infra: change applied at 00:06 UTC.
Nadia - Prod Telemetry: saw drop in SRV error rate within 30s. Errors down ~70% and latency median back to normal.
Maya - Support: Customer A confirms degraded behavior improved, 503s markedly reduced.
Anya P: For stabilization we should cordon any unhealthy consul nodes in us-west-2b and restart coredns proxies that depend on them. I can do a rolling cordon of the 3 nodes flagged unhealthy.
Kai (on-call): agree. Anya, coordinate with Liam so we don't remove all endpoints simultaneously.
Anya P: Starting cordon+restart (sequence: consul-uw2b-03 -> coredns-uw2b-02 -> consul-uw2b-02).
Liam - Infra: I will watch routing. If cluster loses quorum we'll immediately increase weight back to a=100.
Jamal R: adding temporary alert suppression for noisy consul leader-election alerts so we don't page more people while we're mitigating.
SRE Bot: Alert suppression set for consul-leader-* in us-west-2 for 15m by Jamal R.
Kai (on-call): quick check: any sign of config push causing the flap?
Anya P: No config pushes in the window. Logs show TCP retransmits and partial connect timeouts to port 8600 from nodes in the same AZ. Suspect infra networking issue.
Nadia - Prod Telemetry: adding correlation: cloud provider reported increased API errors for host routing in us-west-2b at ~00:00-00:05 UTC (third-party). I'll attach the provider status link in the incident doc.
Maya - Support: Customers impacted: Customer A (dedicated chat) and Customer B (startup provisioning). ETA to fully restore for both depends on final routing removal and node recovery.
Kai (on-call): mitigation status: routing shift applied, cordon+restart underway, suppression on noisy alerts. Next: confirm consul cluster healthy (quorum), then slowly restore normal weights.
Liam - Infra: consul nodes show quorum regained after cordon/restart sequence. coredns proxies healthy and responding.
Nadia - Prod Telemetry: SRV errors back to baseline; latency stable.
Maya - Support: I'll message customers with a summary: cause suspected infra routing flap in us-west-2b, mitigation: traffic shifted to us-west-2a and nodes restarted, ongoing monitoring.
Kai (on-call): handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. Liam, Anya, please own postmortem and follow-up action items (networking RCA with cloud provider, add stronger cross-AZ routing fallback in router, improved escalation on consul leader churn).
Liam - Infra: taking postmortem lead. Will open incident ticket and assign actions.
Anya P: I'll collect logs, include coredns/consul crashloop/sync timestamps, and propose a retry/backoff hardening for SRV lookups.
Jamal R: I'll prepare a playbook entry for rapid route-weight shifts and a checklist for suppressions.
Kai (on-call): Thanks everyone. Leaving the channel, watch for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
SRE Bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) for now. Please update incident tracker: INC-1918765432.
